4. Mr. Harendra Nath Nandy, the learned Advocate for the Petitioner ,took me to the impugned order and submitted that the decree passed in' a suit for Specific Performance of Contract is executable under Order 21 Rule 32(5) of the Code of Civil Procedure. He submitted that the plaintiff made a prayer in the suit for execution and registration of a Kabala deed through. Court and as well as Khas possession in the said land but the Court due to inadvertence had decreed the suit only for registration of the deed: He submitted that in view of the Order 21 Rule 32(5) of the Code: of Civil Procedure the Court is empowered to hand over delivery Of Khas possession in the suit land in favour of the decree holder. In support of his contention he cited the case of Maksud Ali and another- versus Sekandar Ali, reported in 28 DLR: (AD) 99 paragraph 38. 

 7. In the prayer portion of the plaint the plaintiff has made a prayer for getting khas  possession in the suit land but: in the decree the Court has simply decreed the suit as it appears from the certified copy of the decree passed in the suit, which has been marked as exhibit- MO .the revisional application.
